---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on design-based inference and machine-learning-assisted
estimators for finite populations, inference from non-probability samples, and
small-area estimation, with an emphasis on official statistics.

## Preprints

- Ferreira, J. P. (2026). **Direct domain estimation via regression-tree-assisted
  estimators in the production of official statistics.** arXiv:2606.08289 [stat.ME].
  <https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08289>

- Ferreira, J. P., & Goyeneche, J. J. (2026). **Weighting a Census as a
  Non-Probability Sample: A Doubly Robust Framework for Correcting Differential
  Undercoverage in Uruguay's 2023 Census.** arXiv:2606.05666 [stat.ME].
  <https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05666>

- Ferreira, J. P. (2026). **weightflow: Declarative Staged Survey Weighting and
  Recipe-Aware Variance Estimation in R.** Working paper.
